items.exampleEn: The old baker trains one new apprentice every year.
items.exampleZh: 那位老麵包師傅每年訓練一位新學徒。

items.exampleEn: Please bring your teaching credentials to the interview.
items.exampleZh: 面試時請帶著你的教師資格證明。

items.exampleEn: She works in occupational safety at a large factory.
items.exampleZh: 她在一家大工廠負責職業安全。

items.exampleEn: A good manager listens to her subordinates.
items.exampleZh: 好的主管會傾聽部屬的意見。

items.exampleEn: He professes to know nothing about the missing money.
items.exampleZh: 他聲稱對那筆不見的錢一無所知。

items.exampleEn: The nurses showed great professionalism during the busy night.
items.exampleZh: 護理師們在忙碌的夜裡展現了高度的專業精神。

items.exampleEn: She did a three-year apprenticeship as a chef.
items.exampleZh: 她當了三年的廚師學徒。

items.exampleEn: The farm overseer checks the fields every morning.
items.exampleZh: 農場的監工每天早上都會巡視田地。

items.exampleEn: Her first novel is on the shortlist for a national book prize.
items.exampleZh: 她的第一本小說入圍了一個全國性圖書獎的決選名單。
items.glossZh: 最終候選名單；列入候選

items.sentenceEn: My older brother started an apprenticeship at a car repair shop.
items.sentenceZh: 我哥哥在一家汽車修理廠開始當學徒。

items.audioEn: Out of fifty people who applied, only four made the shortlist.
items.audioZh: 五十位應徵者中，只有四個人進入最終候選名單。
items.questionZh: 有幾個人進入最終候選名單？

items.sentenceEn: Customers praised the staff for their professionalism.
items.sentenceZh: 顧客稱讚員工的專業表現。

items.sentenceEn: The overseer made sure every worker wore a helmet.
items.sentenceZh: 監工確保每一位工人都戴著安全帽。

items.stemEn: Many electricians learn their skills during a four-year ____.
items.stemZh: 許多電工是在四年的學徒期間學會技術的。

items.stemEn: We will ____ five people for the final interview.
items.stemZh: 我們會挑出五個人列入最後一輪面試的名單。

items.passageEn: Mr. Lin runs a small workshop that makes wooden chairs. Last month he needed a new apprentice, and more than thirty young people applied. He did not care much about paper credentials; instead, he made a shortlist of five people who had made something with their hands. During the final interview, one young woman professed a deep love of wood, but what impressed him most was her professionalism: she arrived early, asked careful questions and cleaned her tools afterwards. She will spend two years as his apprentice, and he hopes she will one day have subordinates of her own.
items.passageZh: Lin 先生經營一間製作木椅的小工坊。上個月他需要一位新學徒，有三十多個年輕人來應徵。他不太在乎紙上的資格證明，而是從曾經親手做過東西的人當中，列出五人的最終候選名單。最後一次面試時，一位年輕女子表示自己非常熱愛木頭，但最讓他印象深刻的是她的專業態度：她提早到、問題問得很仔細，結束後還把工具清乾淨。她將跟著他當兩年的學徒，他希望她有一天也能帶領自己的部屬。

questions.questionZh: Lin 先生怎麼挑選最終候選人？
options: 請以前的學徒幫忙推薦人選
看誰的資格證明最多最完整
讓應徵者先做一張完整的木椅
挑曾親手做過東西的人

questions.questionZh: 最讓 Lin 先生印象深刻的是什麼？
options: 她說自己從小就跟爸爸學做椅子
她提早到又細心的專業態度

items.promptZh: 噪音是建築工人的職業風險之一。
referenceEn: Noise is one of the occupational risks for building workers.
Loud noise is an occupational risk for people who work on building sites.
rubricZh: occupational 是形容詞，表示「職業的、職業上的」（例如 occupational risks、occupational safety 等）
「噪音」可寫，例如 noise、loud noise 等
「職業風險」可寫，例如 occupational risk、occupational hazard 等

items.instructionZh: 用 apprentice 造一個句子，說說你想跟誰學一門手藝。
referenceEn: I would like to be an apprentice to a famous chef.
If I could, I would work as an apprentice in a bike shop.
rubricZh: apprentice 是名詞，表示「學徒」（例如 be an apprentice to…、work as an apprentice 等）
句子要說到你自己的想法

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：「長時間坐著是辦公室工作的職業風險之一」屬健康主張，接近 §11-30「不寫健康迷思或保健建議」；建議換成中性職業安全情境（例如工廠噪音、搬重物）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 翻譯改成中性職業安全情境「噪音是建築工人的職業風險之一」，參考答案與評分要點同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似："My brother" 譯「我哥哥」多加了年長資訊（§11-20）；建議譯「我的兄弟」或英文改 older brother。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 英文改 My older brother，與「我哥哥」一致

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：shortlist 卡與聽選、閱讀都是求職決選名單
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 Her first novel is on the shortlist for a national book prize.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：apprenticeship mcq 與卡都是「She＋N 年學徒期」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 Many electricians learn their skills during a four-year ____.，代入後只有 apprenticeship 成立

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：中文欄人名一律保留英文名，不音譯
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 「林先生」改「Lin 先生」，題目同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：occupational 是形容詞，表示「職業的、職業上的」（例如 occupational risks、occupational safety 等）／「噪音」可寫，例如 noise、loud noise 等／「職業風險」可寫，例如 occupational risk、occupational hazard 等
